dog.description_text:
Meet Queenie! 👑💗

Attention, dog lovers! Meet Queenie — an affectionate, wiggly mama who would love nothing more than to become the queen of your heart.

Queenie is a 4-year-old mixed-breed girl with gorgeous brindle coloring and deep, soulful eyes you could get lost in. She is sweet, easygoing, and incredibly affectionate. Her favorite things are giving kisses, getting pets and cuddles, and being as close to her people as possible. If you’re looking for a dog who would happily be your lap dog, Queenie may be your girl!

She hasn’t been in our care for very long, but everything we’ve learned about her so far has made us love her — and we think you will, too!

🐾 A Little About Queenie

🎓 Commands:
Queenie knows her basic commands, including sit, lay down, and stay. She is very smart and treat motivated and learns very quickly with positive reinforcement.

🚶 Leash Manners:
Queenie is a lovely walking companion. She is alert and curious about her surroundings. She is learning to be a loose leash dog and absolutely loves running. She is really playful and loves saying hi to people during her walk. We’re working on minimising her excitement on seeing other dogs.

❤️ People, Kids & Dogs:
Queenie is a very loving girl who eagerly greets the neighbours she meets. She tends to jump in excitement but is learning to calm herself. She is great with house guests and loves getting belly rubs and being affectionate. She has been great and playful with older children. She is also very calm with other dogs. She is aware of a resident dog in her foster home and has shown no issues, although they are currently being kept separate as a medical precaution.

💋 Queenie LOVES:
Giving kisses, getting pets and cuddles, and being close to her people. Outside she absolutely loves running, if you’re active- she is definitely your girl! She would happily soak up all the affection you’re willing to give!

🏡 Potty Training:
Queenie is well house-trained and understands that potty time happens outside and also communicates well when she needs to pee.

🛏️ Crating & Gating:
Queenie is currently gated in the living room when left alone and at night where she sleeps on her bed. She is not too fond of her crate but loves her cosy bed and happily stays in the living room when her fosters leave.

👑 Queenie’s Story

Queenie has already been through more than any dog should have to endure. She was found after giving birth to her puppies behind a dumpster in Brooklyn. Despite everything she has experienced, she remains sweet, affectionate, and eager to love the people around her.

Now, it’s Queenie’s turn to be cared for.

She deserves a family who will show her just how wonderful life can be — and in return, she’ll give you love, kisses, cuddles, and loyalty tenfold.

If you think Queenie might be your girl, apply for adoption and come meet her. We have a feeling she may just steal your heart. ❤️👑
